answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, split across independent auditors, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. A crystal of per-task receipts records who did what, and the oasis of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. What survives to the whisper is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
